description:
## Goal

Make every production job run complete into the existing dependency ledger with one typed `AttemptOutcome`: its exact fact/product observations and one of `Complete(publication)`, `Blocked`, or `Failed(diagnostic)`.

## Contract

- Complete installs the already validated typed publication from `fz-tfn.53` and replaces the job's observations/claims.
- Failed owns its immutable diagnostic and actual observations, withdraws stale prior claims, and remains subscribed to the exact dependencies that can make a correction relevant.
- Blocked retains only publications still justified by the accepted immutable source; waiting is not accidental success and does not discard reads already made.
- Relevant movement wakes an attempt once. Repeating an unchanged failure or changing an unrelated source performs no requested-root retry.
- Job identity and DependencyIndex remain the sole attempt/read/wait/output authority. A diagnostic is an outcome, not a second retry registry.

Apply this outcome to current source, semantic, and product-dependent jobs before live replacement exists. Do not add a failed-job map, retry queue, rollback World, observation reconstruction, invented producer, global scan, or compatibility exit path.

## TDD signal

At production boundaries prove parse/scope/definition/macro/semantic/product dependency failures after partial reads; prior success followed by failure; Blocked followed by Failed; failed shared roots; unchanged retry; unrelated edit; exact relevant correction; and deterministic FIFO/LIFO/permuted wakes. The failure retains the right diagnostic/provenance and observations, stale claims disappear, independently owned claims remain, and successful correction publishes once.

Every started job has exactly one applied completion record. Telemetry derives failure and wake causality from that record; it does not repair missing state.

## Required deletion

Delete `FatalError` drive exits that bypass completion, ad hoc diagnostic flushing/ownership, stale-claim preservation made necessary only by lost failed effects, failed-job/retry concepts, transition adapters, and docs/tests describing errors as outside the fact engine.

This is the corrected standalone form of the former contract absorbed into `fz-tfn.57`. No parked implementation is restored. Full focused/deterministic/library/fixture/CLI gates, formatting, check, and strict Clippy pass. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes one commit and close.
title: Complete every compiler attempt into the dependency ledger
